items.contentSnippet: Learn how Airbnb is expanding access to GPT-6 Astra and OpenAI frontier models to help engineering teams solve bugs, design systems, and ship faster.

summaries.zh: Airbnb已扩大对GPT-6 Astra和OpenAI前沿模型的访问权限，以帮助工程团队解决错误、设计系统并加速产品发布。
summaries.en: Airbnb is expanding access to GPT-6 Astra and OpenAI frontier models to assist engineering teams. These tools will help teams resolve bugs, design systems, and accelerate project delivery. The initiative aims to enhance productivity and efficiency in software development.

items.summary: Airbnb已扩大对GPT-6 Astra和OpenAI前沿模型的访问权限，以帮助工程团队解决错误、设计系统并加速产品发布。

items.title: Grab and OpenAI bring practical AI skills to Southeast Asia
items.content: OpenAI and Grab launch GO Forward with AI, a regional programme helping 30,000 partners build practical AI skills across Southeast Asia.
items.contentSnippet: OpenAI and Grab launch GO Forward with AI, a regional programme helping 30,000 partners build practical AI skills across Southeast Asia.

summaries.zh: OpenAI与Grab启动“GO Forward with AI”区域计划，旨在帮助东南亚30,000名合作伙伴提升实用AI技能。该计划旨在推动AI技术在区域内的实际应用，提升合作伙伴的AI能力。
summaries.en: OpenAI and Grab have launched GO Forward with AI, a regional initiative aimed at equipping 30,000 Southeast Asian partners with practical AI skills. The program focuses on delivering hands-on training and resources to enhance AI capabilities in the region.

items.summary: OpenAI与Grab启动“GO Forward with AI”区域计划，旨在帮助东南亚30,000名合作伙伴提升实用AI技能。该计划旨在推动AI技术在区域内的实际应用，提升合作伙伴的AI能力。

items.title: Better prompt caching for GPT-6
items.content: Learn how GPT-6 improves prompt caching with higher cache hit rates, new diagnostics, explicit breakpoints, and controls that reduce latency and costs.
items.contentSnippet: Learn how GPT-6 improves prompt caching with higher cache hit rates, new diagnostics, explicit breakpoints, and controls that reduce latency and costs.

summaries.zh: GPT-6通过提高缓存命中率、引入新的诊断工具、设置显式断点和控制功能，优化了提示缓存。这些改进有助于降低延迟和成本。
summaries.en: GPT-6 enhances prompt caching by achieving higher cache hit rates, introducing new diagnostics, enabling explicit breakpoints, and providing controls to minimize latency and costs. These improvements optimize performance and reduce expenses for users.

items.summary: GPT-6通过提高缓存命中率、引入新的诊断工具、设置显式断点和控制功能，优化了提示缓存。这些改进有助于降低延迟和成本。

items.title: Introducing GPT-6 Sol and Luna
items.content: Meet GPT-6 Sol and Luna, two models that bring frontier intelligence to everyday work with different balances of capability and cost.
items.contentSnippet: Meet GPT-6 Sol and Luna, two models that bring frontier intelligence to everyday work with different balances of capability and cost.

summaries.zh: GPT-6 Sol和Luna是两款前沿智能模型，旨在将先进技术应用于日常工作中。它们在能力和成本上实现了不同平衡，以满足多样化的需求。
summaries.en: GPT-6 Sol and Luna are two models designed to integrate advanced AI into everyday tasks. They offer distinct balances of capability and cost, catering to different needs. Sol and Luna bring frontier intelligence to general work applications, providing flexible options for users.

items.summary: GPT-6 Sol和Luna是两款前沿智能模型，旨在将先进技术应用于日常工作中。它们在能力和成本上实现了不同平衡，以满足多样化的需求。

items.title: Parallel cut research time and cost in half with GPT‑6 Astra
items.content: GPT‑6 Astra allowed Parallel’s agents to research and synthesize labor-market data in half the time and at half the cost vs. prior models.
items.contentSnippet: GPT‑6 Astra allowed Parallel’s agents to research and synthesize labor-market data in half the time and at half the cost vs. prior models.

summaries.zh: GPT-6 Astra使Parallel的代理在研究合成劳动力市场数据方面，相比之前的模型将时间和成本减半。
summaries.en: GPT‑6 Astra enables Parallel’s agents to research and synthesize labor-market data in half the time and cost compared to previous models.

items.summary: GPT-6 Astra使Parallel的代理在研究合成劳动力市场数据方面，相比之前的模型将时间和成本减半。

items.title: Priorities and principles for effective third party assessments
items.content: OpenAI outlines priorities and principles for rigorous, secure, and independent third-party AI safety assessments of frontier models and safeguards.
items.contentSnippet: OpenAI outlines priorities and principles for rigorous, secure, and independent third-party AI safety assessments of frontier models and safeguards.

summaries.zh: OpenAI提出了针对前沿模型和防护措施进行严格、安全、独立第三方AI安全评估的优先事项和原则。
summaries.en: OpenAI has outlined key priorities and principles for effective third-party AI safety assessments. These principles emphasize rigorous, secure, and independent evaluations of frontier AI models and their safeguards. The guidelines aim to ensure thorough and unbiased assessments to enhance AI safety and reliability.

items.summary: OpenAI提出了针对前沿模型和防护措施进行严格、安全、独立第三方AI安全评估的优先事项和原则。
